verses.kjv: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.modern: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah — the word he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
verses.modern: Hear, all You peoples. Listen, O earth, and everything in it. Let the Lord GOD be a witness against you — the Lord from His holy temple.

verses.kjv: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
verses.modern: For the LORD comes forth out of His place. He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

verses.kjv: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.
verses.modern: The mountains will melt beneath Him, and the valleys will split apart — like wax before the fire, like waters poured down a steep slope.

verses.kjv: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
verses.modern: All this is for the transgression of Jacob and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Are they not Jerusalem?

verses.kjv: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.
verses.modern: Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of ruins in the open field, a place for planting a vineyard. I will pour down her stones into the valley, and I will lay bare her foundations.

verses.kjv: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
verses.modern: All her carved images will be beaten to pieces, and all her wages will be burned with fire. I will lay all her idols desolate, for she gathered them from the wages of a harlot, and to the wages of a harlot they will return.

verses.kjv: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
verses.modern: Therefore I will wail and howl. I will go stripped and naked. I will make a wailing like the dragons and a mourning like the owls.

verses.kjv: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: For her wound is incurable, and it has come even to Judah. It has reached the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
verses.modern: Tell it not in Gath. Weep not at all. In the house of Aphrah, roll yourself in the dust.

verses.kjv: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
verses.modern: Pass on your way, you who live in Saphir, in shameful nakedness. The one who lives in Zaanan does not come out. The mourning of Beth-ezel will take from you its place to stand.

verses.kjv: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: For the one who lives in Maroth waited anxiously for good — but evil came down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.
verses.modern: You who live in Lachish, harness the chariot to the swift horse. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion, for the transgressions of Israel were found in You.

verses.kjv: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
verses.modern: Therefore You will give parting gifts to Moresheth-gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deception to the kings of Israel.

verses.kjv: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.
verses.modern: I will yet bring an heir to You, O inhabitant of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

verses.kjv: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
verses.modern: Make Yourself bald and shave Your head for the children You delight in. Make Your baldness as wide as the eagle's, for they have gone from You into captivity.

chapters.summary: The LORD comes down from His holy temple to tread upon the high places of the earth. Samaria will be made a heap of rubble — her images beaten to pieces and her idols burned. The wound is incurable and reaches to the gate of Jerusalem itself. Micah mourns for the cities of Judah one by one.

verses.kjv: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
verses.modern: Woe to those who devise iniquity and plot evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they carry it out, because it is in the power of their hand.

verses.kjv: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
verses.modern: They covet fields and seize them by violence. They covet houses and take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his inheritance.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I am devising against this family an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.
verses.modern: Therefore the LORD says: I am devising against this family a disaster from which You will not remove Your necks. You will not walk proudly, for this time is evil.

verses.kjv: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.
verses.modern: In that day someone will take up a proverb against you and lament with a bitter lamentation, saying, "We are utterly ruined. He has changed the portion of my people. How He has taken it from me! He has turned away and divided our fields."

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD.
verses.modern: Therefore You will have no one to cast a measuring line by lot in the congregation of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.
verses.modern: "Do not prophesy," they say to those who prophesy. They will not prophesy to them, so that disgrace will not overtake them.

verses.kjv: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
verses.modern: O You who are called the house of Jacob, is the Spirit of the LORD restricted? Are these His doings? Do not My words do good to the one who walks uprightly?

verses.kjv: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
verses.modern: Even lately My people have risen up as an enemy. You pull off the robe along with the garment from those who pass by securely, as men turning away from war.

verses.kjv: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.
verses.modern: You have cast out the women of My people from their pleasant houses. From their children You have taken away My glory forever.

verses.kjv: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
verses.modern: Arise and depart, for this is not Your rest. Because it is defiled, it will destroy You with a grievous destruction.

verses.kjv: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.
verses.modern: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, "I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink" — he will be the prophet of this people.

verses.kjv: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.
verses.modern: I will surely assemble all of you, O Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together like the sheep of Bozrah, like a flock in the middle of its fold. They will make a great noise because of the crowd of people.

verses.kjv: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.
verses.modern: The One who breaks through has gone up before them. They have broken out, passed through the gate, and gone out by it. Their king will pass before them, and the LORD at their head.

chapters.summary: Woe to those who lie awake plotting wickedness and seize fields and houses by violence. The LORD plans disaster against this family of oppressors. False prophets tell the people what they want to hear, but the LORD will gather the remnant of Israel like sheep in a fold, and their king will pass through before them with the LORD at their head.

verses.kjv: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?
verses.modern: And I said, "Hear, I ask you, O heads of Jacob, and you princes of the house of Israel. Is it not for you to know justice?

verses.kjv: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
verses.modern: You who hate the good and love the evil, who tear the skin from off My people and the flesh from off their bones —

verses.kjv: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
verses.modern: who also eat the flesh of My people and strip their skin from them, who break their bones and chop them in pieces, like meat for the pot, like flesh within the cauldron."

verses.kjv: Then shall they cry unto the LORD, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
verses.modern: Then they will cry to the LORD, but He will not hear them. He will even hide His face from them at that time, because they have done evil in their deeds.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him:
verses.modern: This is what the LORD says concerning the prophets who lead My people astray, who bite with their teeth and cry, "Peace" — but who prepare war against anyone who does not put food into their mouths:

verses.kjv: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
verses.modern: Therefore it will be night to You, without a vision. It will be dark to You, without divination. The sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be dark over them.

verses.kjv: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
verses.modern: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners confounded. They will all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.

verses.kjv: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
verses.modern: But truly I am full of power by the Spirit of the LORD, and of justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.

verses.kjv: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
verses.modern: Hear this, I ask you, you heads of the house of Jacob and princes of the house of Israel, who hate justice and pervert all that is right.

verses.kjv: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
verses.modern: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

verses.kjv: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the LORD, and say, Is not the LORD among us? none evil can come upon us.
verses.modern: Her heads judge for a bribe, her priests teach for hire, and her prophets divine for money. Yet they lean on the LORD and say, "Is not the LORD among us? No evil can come upon us."

verses.kjv: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
verses.modern: Therefore for Your sake Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become heaps of ruins, and the mountain of the house will be like the high places of a forest.

chapters.summary: Micah rebukes the leaders of Israel who hate good and love evil, who tear the skin from the people and eat their flesh. The prophets lead the people astray — they cry "Peace" when they are fed, but declare war against those who give them nothing. Because of them, Zion will be plowed like a field and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble.

verses.kjv: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.
verses.modern: But in the last days it will come to pass that the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established in the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills. And peoples will flow to it.

verses.kjv: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Many nations will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in His paths." For the law will go forth out of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.modern: He will judge among many peoples and rebuke strong nations far away. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up a sword against nation, nor will they learn war any more.

verses.kjv: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken it.
verses.modern: Every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree, and no one will make them afraid, for the mouth of the LORD of hosts has spoken it.

verses.kjv: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.
verses.modern: For all peoples will walk, every one in the name of his god — but we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: In that day, saith the LORD, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
verses.modern: In that day, says the LORD, I will assemble the lame. I will gather the one driven away, and the one I have afflicted.

verses.kjv: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
verses.modern: I will make the lame a remnant, and the one cast far off a strong nation. The LORD will reign over them in Mount Zion from now on, even for ever.

verses.kjv: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: And You, O tower of the flock, the stronghold of the daughter of Zion — to You it will come, even the former dominion. The kingdom will come to the daughter of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.
verses.modern: Now why do You cry out aloud? Is there no king in You? Has Your counselor perished, that pains have seized You like a woman in labor?

verses.kjv: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the LORD shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
verses.modern: Be in pain and labor to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor. For now you will go forth out of the city, and You will live in the field. You will go even to Babylon. There You will be delivered. There the LORD will redeem You from the hand of Your enemies.

verses.kjv: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
verses.modern: Now also many nations are gathered against You, who say, "Let her be defiled, and let our eye gaze on Zion."

verses.kjv: But they know not the thoughts of the LORD, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.
verses.modern: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD, nor do they understand His counsel. For He will gather them like sheaves to the threshing floor.

verses.kjv: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the LORD, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.modern: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion. For I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hooves bronze. You will beat in pieces many peoples, and I will consecrate their gain to the LORD, their wealth to the Lord of the whole earth.

chapters.summary: In the last days the mountain of the LORD's house will be established above all mountains, and nations will flow to it. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and nation will not lift up sword against nation. Though Israel now goes into exile in Babylon, the LORD will redeem her there and gather her like sheaves to the threshing floor.

verses.kjv: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.
verses.modern: Now gather Yourself in troops, O daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel on the cheek with a rod.

verses.kjv: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
verses.modern: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall He come forth unto Me that is to be ruler in Israel — whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

verses.kjv: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.
verses.modern: Therefore He will give them up, until the time when she who is in labor has brought forth. Then the remnant of His brothers will return to the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
verses.modern: He will stand and feed his flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD His God. And they will abide, for now He will be great to the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.
verses.modern: And this Man will be the peace, when the Assyrian comes into our land. When he treads in our palaces, then we will raise against him seven shepherds and eight principal men.

verses.kjv: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.
verses.modern: They will lay waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod at its entrances. So He will deliver us from the Assyrian when He comes into our land and treads within our borders.

verses.kjv: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the LORD, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.
verses.modern: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass — which does not wait for man nor delay for the sons of men.

verses.kjv: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.
verses.modern: The remnant of Jacob will be among the Gentiles, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep — which, when it passes through, both tramples down and tears in pieces, and none can deliver.

verses.kjv: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.
verses.modern: Your hand will be lifted up against your adversaries, and all your enemies will be cut off.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:
verses.modern: It will come to pass in that day, says the LORD, that I will cut off Your horses from among You, and I will destroy Your chariots.

verses.kjv: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:
verses.modern: I will cut off the cities of Your land and throw down all Your strongholds.

verses.kjv: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:
verses.modern: I will cut off witchcrafts from Your hand, and You will have no more soothsayers.

verses.kjv: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.
verses.modern: I will also cut off Your graven images and Your standing pillars from among You. You will no more worship the work of Your hands.

verses.kjv: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
verses.modern: I will pluck up Your groves from among You, and so I will destroy Your cities.

verses.kjv: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.
verses.modern: I will execute vengeance in anger and fury on the heathen, such as they have not heard.

chapters.summary: Out of Bethlehem Ephratah — small among the clans of Judah — will come forth the ruler of Israel, whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting. He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD. The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations like a lion among flocks of sheep, and the LORD will cut off all idols, witchcraft, and graven images.

verses.kjv: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
verses.modern: Hear now what the LORD says: "Arise, contend before the mountains, and let the hills hear Your voice.

verses.kjv: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD's controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
verses.modern: Hear, O mountains, the LORD's controversy — and You strong foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a controversy with His people, and He will plead with Israel.

verses.kjv: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
verses.modern: O My people, what have I done to you? How have I wearied you? Testify against Me.

verses.kjv: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.modern: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of servants. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

verses.kjv: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD.
verses.modern: O My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered Him — from Shittim to Gilgal — that You may know the righteousness of the LORD."

verses.kjv: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
verses.modern: With what shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the high God? Shall I come before Him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

verses.kjv: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.modern: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

verses.kjv: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
verses.modern: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good. And what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

verses.kjv: The LORD's voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
verses.modern: The LORD's voice cries to the city, and the man of wisdom will see your name. Hear the rod, and Him who appointed it.

verses.kjv: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
verses.modern: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?

verses.kjv: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
verses.modern: Shall I count them pure with wicked balances and with a bag of deceitful weights?

verses.kjv: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
verses.modern: For her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.

verses.kjv: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.
verses.modern: Therefore I also will make you sick by striking you, by making you desolate because of your sins.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
verses.modern: You will eat, but not be satisfied. Your hunger will be in the midst of you. You will take hold, but you will not save, and what you save I will give up to the sword.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.
verses.modern: You will sow, but you will not reap. You will tread the olives, but you will not anoint yourself with oil. You will tread sweet wine, but you will not drink wine.

verses.kjv: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
verses.modern: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and you walk in their counsels. So I will make you a desolation, and her inhabitants a hissing. Therefore you will bear the reproach of My people.

chapters.summary: The LORD brings His case against Israel before the mountains. He asks what He has done to weary them — He brought them out of Egypt, sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam before them. What does the LORD require? "To do justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God." Yet the city is full of violence and deceit, and judgment will fall.

verses.kjv: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.
verses.modern: Woe is me! For I am like one when they have gathered the summer fruits, like the grape gleanings of the vintage. There is no cluster to eat. My soul desired the firstripe fruit.

verses.kjv: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
verses.modern: The good man has perished from the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood. Every man hunts his brother with a net.

verses.kjv: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.
verses.modern: They do evil with both hands eagerly. The prince asks, and the judge asks for a bribe. The great man speaks out his evil desire, and so they weave it together.

verses.kjv: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.
verses.modern: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen — your visitation — comes. Now will be their confusion.

verses.kjv: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
verses.modern: Do not trust in a friend. Do not put confidence in a guide. Keep the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your bosom.

verses.kjv: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
verses.modern: For the son dishonors the father. The daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law. A man's enemies are the men of his own house.

verses.kjv: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
verses.modern: Therefore I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

verses.kjv: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.
verses.modern: Rejoice not against me, O my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.

verses.kjv: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.
verses.modern: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against Him — until He pleads my cause and executes judgment for me. He will bring me forth to the light, and I will see His righteousness.

verses.kjv: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
verses.modern: Then she who is my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, "Where is the LORD Your God?" My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.

verses.kjv: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
verses.modern: In the day when Your walls are to be built — in that day the decree will be far removed.

verses.kjv: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
verses.modern: In that day also He will come to You from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
verses.modern: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who live in it, for the fruit of their doings.

verses.kjv: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
verses.modern: Feed Your people with Your rod, the flock of Your heritage, which dwell alone in the wood, in the midst of Carmel. Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

verses.kjv: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.
verses.modern: As in the days when You came out of the land of Egypt, I will show Him marvellous things.

verses.kjv: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
verses.modern: The nations will see and be confounded at all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.

verses.kjv: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.
verses.modern: They will lick the dust like a serpent. They will move out of their holes like worms of the earth. They will be afraid of the LORD our God, and will fear because of You.

verses.kjv: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
verses.modern: Who is a God like unto Thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of His heritage? He retaineth not His anger for ever, because He delighteth in mercy.

verses.kjv: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
verses.modern: He will turn again. He will have compassion upon us. He will subdue our iniquities, and Thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
verses.modern: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob and the mercy to Abraham, which Thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.

chapters.summary: Micah laments — the godly man has perished, every man hunts his brother with a net, and a man's enemies are the men of his own household. Yet "I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation." The LORD will shepherd His people again, the nations will see and be ashamed. Who is a God like the LORD — who pardons iniquity and casts all their sins into the depths of the sea?
